title: GRU Forward over a Sequence
signature: def gru_forward(x, h0, W_ih, W_hh, b_ih, b_hh) -> np.ndarray
hints: Per step, compute gi = x_t @ W_ih + b_ih and gh = h @ W_hh + b_hh, both (B, 3H). Split each into r, z, n blocks.
r and z add the two halves before the sigmoid. The candidate is n = tanh(gi_n + r * gh_n), and gh_n already includes b_hn.
The update keeps the old state where z is 1: h = (1 - z) * n + z * h.
